_note: robofast PDU server (Alpaca Switch) for the MINERVA T1 APC rack PDU (AP7900), through an SSH tunnel: docs/recovery.md, docs/remote.md.
SNMP is UDP and ssh -L carries TCP only, so the far end of the tunnel is scripts/snmp_relay.py on the site gateway, relaying to the PDU and nothing else; hence pdu.relay true.
Outlet names are the PDU's own (SNMP sPDUOutletCtlName), read 2026-11-02.

Only inst (the Andor camera) and panel (the mount electronics) may be switched or power-cycled (JDE 2026-11-10). Cycling panel drops the mount controller: PWI reconnects and the mount is homed again (the recovery ladder's telescope powercycle rung).
The telcom PC, the heater, the fiber box, the network switch and the monitor can never be switched from here.
credentials: {"read": ..., "write": ...} SNMP communities, chmod 600, outside every repository.
allow_hardware is true, but nothing talks to the real PDU without --hardware on the command line as well (robofast/hwgate.py).
